achados.titulo: O healthcheck do overlay nunca fica saudavel e a api do local-prod nao sobe
achados.evidencia_de_escopo: docker-compose.clamav.yml e arquivo novo do bloco (status A em e78e3968..2746eb60, commit ae12ddab). O commit 3a9b026f (F8) trocou o healthcheck do compose de dev para 127.0.0.1 e deixou o overlay com clamdcheck.sh.
achados.comando: cd C:/Users/AMP/w-jav2 && docker compose -p j-avreal-c2 -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.clamav.yml up -d --no-deps clamav; apos 8 min: docker inspect -f "{{.State.Health.Status}}" j-avreal-c2-clamav-1; docker compose -p j-avreal-c2 -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.clamav.yml up -d --wait --no-deps clamav; docker exec j-avreal-c2-clamav-1 sh -c "/usr/local/bin/clamdcheck.sh; echo exit=\$?; echo PING | nc 127.0.0.1 3310"
achados.saida: unhealthy streak=15; up --wait: 'container j-avreal-c2-clamav-1 is unhealthy', exit 1; clamdcheck.sh: 'ERROR: Unable to contact server', exit 1, com PONG em 127.0.0.1 no mesmo instante. Dependente com a clausula da api (api.depends_on.clamav.condition=service_healthy, c2-sonda-dep.yml): 'dependency failed to start: container j-avreal-c2-clamav-1 is unhealthy', exit 1. O uso documentado (docs/deployment.md, plano §1) nao chega a subir a api. O CI nao roda o overlay; o teste de topologia so le config.

achados.titulo: O clamd do overlay fica sem saida para assinaturas e toda varredura vira 503 signatures_stale
achados.evidencia_de_escopo: docker-compose.clamav.yml novo do bloco (ae12ddab): clamav so na rede clamav_private internal:true, com CLAMAV_MAX_DB_AGE_HOURS=72 e freshclam ligado. O plano §1 pede as duas coisas (rede interna e freshclam 12x/dia) sem dizer como o freshclam sai; docs/deployment.md nao trata disso no local-prod. Nenhuma pendencia registrada.
achados.comando: cd C:/Users/AMP/w-jav2 && docker compose -p j-avreal-c2 -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.clamav.yml up -d --no-deps clamav; docker exec j-avreal-c2-clamav-1 sh -c "date -u; echo VERSION | nc 127.0.0.1 3310; wget -q -T 5 -O /dev/null https://database.clamav.net/; echo wget=\$?"; docker logs j-avreal-c2-clamav-1 2>&1 | grep -E "Update failed|resolve hostname"; node --import tsx C:/Users/AMP/erp-pausa-2026-10-03/juntas/J-B-AV-REAL/c2-sonda-relay.mts
achados.saida: 'Could not resolve hostname', 'ERROR: Update failed'; wget bad address; VERSION 'ClamAV 1.4.6/28164/Sun Oct 25 06:24:12 2026' com date 'Oct 31 22:46:27 2026' (~160 h, acima de 72 h, ja no primeiro boot). Adaptador real: maxDbAgeHours 72 -> failed/signatures_stale; 0 -> clean. Vermelho-controle: docker network connect bridge + freshclam -> 'daily.cld updated', e a mesma sonda com 72 -> clean. Falha fechada: nada passa sem varredura, mas nenhum upload limpo e aceito nas 5 vias.
